protocol: single batched request per model, 36 independent questions; no answer-specific retries; identical state/rubric; latency measured per batch, not per case
limitations: Agent-authored labels are human-verifiable but not independently human-labeled.
Synthetic minimal cases, correlated triplets, no real long-context PACBench cases.
One latency measurement per model; batch speed, not per-case latency distribution.
Shared state includes all cases, so interference and cross-case leakage are possible.
DeepSeek uses strict JSON-schema chat, decisions use Choice; label output only, not full PACBench explanations/diagnostics.
No independent reviewer or human adjudicator; omitted claim vs explicit denial of source knowledge is rubric-dependent.
DeepSeek V4 Pro received cached tokens; actual costs are not directly normalized.
